cues: Silver nitrate is called lunar caustic: luna was the alchemists' name for silver, and the solid burns skin.
It is made by dissolving silver in nitric acid.
If the silver contained copper, heating to four fifty degrees turns copper nitrate into insoluble black oxide, and the silver nitrate is extracted with water.
